units.source_text: 四日是星期天，庭院里也绽开了一两朵梅花。

en.t: The fourth was a Sunday, and one or two plum blossoms had opened in the garden as well.

units.source_text: 周末客人比较多，今天将对局室迁到了新馆。

en.t: Since there were more guests on the weekend, the game room was moved to the new building today.

units.source_text: 我经常在名人的邻室下榻。

en.t: I often stayed in the room next to the Master's.

units.source_text: 名人的房间安排在新馆的里首。

en.t: The Master's room was arranged at the far end of the new building.

units.source_text: 头天晚上，二楼两间房子被棋赛工作人员占据了。

en.t: The night before, two rooms on the second floor had been taken by the tournament staff.

units.source_text: 就是说，不住进别的客人，保证让名人安眠。

en.t: In other words, no other guests were put there, so that the Master would be assured a peaceful sleep.

units.source_text: 大竹七段原住新馆二楼，据说他身体欠佳，上下楼梯很是不便，昨天还是前天迁到了一楼。

en.t: Otaka, a seventh-dan player, had originally been staying on the second floor of the new building, but he was said to be in poor health and found the stairs very inconvenient, so yesterday or the day before he moved down to the first floor.
